'As an additional cost to play Hungering Slaughterbeast, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.' + printed **Blood Debt**. Shadow Brute Action - Attack (LeviaBlitzDeck printing; identical text to the blue sibling .drafts/hungering_slaughterbeast_blue.json, whose shape this copies verbatim - no amount differs between printings).

BLOOD DEBT NOT AUTHORED: printed_keywords carries BloodDebt - a CR section 8 keyword on the card DB keywords field, implemented engine-side (ability_keywords.blood_debt); re-authoring it would be a defect.

COST NOT EFFECT: 'As an additional cost to play' must be able to BLOCK the play, so it lives in the ability-level additional_cost array, never as an ON_PLAY effect. BANISH_RANDOM_FROM_GRAVEYARD (cost_types.py:192-224, read this session) is the exact primitive the triage named and reads exactly one parameter, amount: can_pay requires >= N cards in the controller's graveyard (so with fewer than 3 graveyard cards the play is not offered), and pay samples N at random and removes them via the canonical banish with origin_zone='graveyard' (so they leave the graveyard - no double-zone bug). Mandatory and unchosen, matching 'banish 3 random'.

EMPTY EFFECTS LIST IS THE DOCUMENTED SHAPE here, per the Scrap pattern in DSL_REFERENCE ('{"ability_type": "PLAY", "additional_cost": [...], "effects": []}'): the card's only authored text is its cost line; the attack itself needs no authored ability because an Action - Attack card is put onto the combat chain by the engine from its type/subtype when played.

On adoption, file under a set folder derived from the card's own setIdentifiers (batch says LeviaBlitzDeck).

No gaps.
